$schema_note: Not validated by JSON Schema yet; treat as registry. Consumed by Steward (see AGENT_MAPPING.json#agents.Steward).
purpose: Single source of truth for every external durable layer the orchestration layer may touch. Steward uses this to enforce §5 retry/fallback. Do NOT duplicate Notion/Drive specifics that already live in DUAL_WRITE_GOVERNOR.json — cross-link instead.

dedupe_key_formula.policy: Compute before every durable write. Found → UPDATE in place. Never create a duplicate.

retry_policy.on_final_failure: Enqueue to dead_letter; alert; NEVER drop the payload (§5).

notion_down.action: Write the record to Drive and a local sandbox queue; mark notion_pending=true.
notion_down.replay_owner: Steward replays queue when Notion returns.

drive_down.action: Write to Notion; hold the doc body in the dead-letter queue for later mirror.
drive_down.replay_owner: Steward replays queue when Drive returns.

github_down.action: Keep working from cached/raw repo; queue commits; flag repo_pending.
github_down.replay_owner: Steward replays on next successful network probe.

all_down_or_sandbox_only.action: Serialize every result to a single JSON bundle and PRINT it in full to stdout (§1.1).
all_down_or_sandbox_only.replay_owner: Operator saves the printed payload to a durable layer by hand.

dead_letter.purpose: Hold any payload that cannot be persisted after retries. Never silent drop.
dead_letter.primary_jsonl_status: TODO — not yet declared in NIZAM_TEMPLE.json#ledgers (operator action: add with privacy=strict_local and gitignore it).
dead_letter.stdout_fallback: If even the JSONL cannot be written (e.g. read-only sandbox), Steward prints the full bundle to stdout.

audit_log.payload_storage_rule: HASH ONLY + ≤ 400 chars excerpt. NEVER the full message text or any token. (§3)

secret_scan.on_hit: Abort the push/write. Surface the file:line so operator can rotate the secret and rewrite history if needed.

github.role: Source of truth for code, schemas, contract docs, diagrams (§0). Steward commits + Almanac /docs writes.
github.auth_default: git credential helper / SSH key on host

drive.role: Human-readable narrative companion to every Notion row (§5 dual-write).
drive.share_policy: NOT world-shared; share only with the service account / owner (§3).

notion.role: Queryable structured rows (Pulse, Witness, Audit Log).
notion.share_policy: Restricted to the owner; do not change sharing programmatically (§3).

telegram.role: Warden capture channel for ad-hoc operator notes.
telegram.gap: No adapter exists in repo yet; tracked in AGENT_MAPPING.json#agents.Warden.gaps.

gmail.role: Warden capture channel for forwarded or labeled email.
gmail.gap: No adapter exists in repo yet; tracked in AGENT_MAPPING.json#agents.Warden.gaps.

llm_runtime.note: Never log prompts/responses with secrets. Audit Log stores hashes (§3).

serpapi_marsad.role: Primary flight-price feed for MARSAD module (out-of-scope for the orchestration layer; listed here so secret-scan and env-var inventory are exhaustive).
